claims.quote: A find gives one value for every match of the variables the solver works out, as it does for values a schema lists, so a variable its template leaves out still makes its own matches: with ?x from -2 to 2, a find of a cond on ?x gives "other" three times and "pos" twice.
A rule that aggregates combines one value from each match of the variables the solver works out, as it does for values a schema lists.
A variable that a goal about the solver's values defines with cond takes the value of each case that can hold, not only of the first the solver finds.
